annotation.title_clean: 「臺灣AI行動計畫2.0」於114年度預計投入157億餘元，允宜建置統籌檢討機制並完善AI法制作業，以強化各細部計畫之鏈結，俾達成厚植AI國力目標
annotation.title_en: Taiwan AI Action Plan 2.0 to invest over NT$15.7 billion in FY2025; an overarching review mechanism should be established and AI legal framework improved to strengthen linkage among sub-plans
annotation.summary_en: Legislative Yuan budget review item on Taiwan's AI Action Plan 2.0 (2023–2026), planned NT$15.75 billion for FY2025. It notes low execution rates and cross-ministry fragmentation, and recommends an overarching review mechanism, completing AI legislation (draft AI Basic Act), and preparing for AI electricity demand and talent needs.
key_provisions_or_claims: FY2025 budget for AI Action Plan 2.0 is NT$15.748 billion, up NT$3.6 billion from FY2024.
FY2024 execution through Q2 was only 33.75% of annual budget.
Recommends an overarching review mechanism to link sub-plans across ministries.
Urges completion of AI legal framework; draft AI Basic Act pre-announced July 2024.
Notes AI electricity demand growth and talent shortages requiring preparation.
